name: known-gap-domain-enum-loses-industry
reason: The persona's top two positive preferences are 'logistics' (weight 9) and 'supply chain' (weight 8), and this JD is a freight visibility platform -- the single best domain match in the whole fixture set. Both are reported as preference GAPS anyway. jd_extraction.tmpl constrains `domain` to a closed enum with no logistics or freight value, so the closest honest extraction is 'saas'. The real industry survives only in screening_summary.industry ('freight logistics'), which signalFields does not read. The result inverts the strongest signal in the dataset: the JD the persona most wants is scored as though it failed to mention the thing they care most about.
description: Asserted separately from strong-match.json so the enforced case can hold a real preference floor while this stays visible.

culture_signals: mentorship is an explicit part of the role
